title: P12a — Mount registered frame effects from XML
description:
Implement the missing shared registry effect mounting in actual XML player and renderer so P12 source snippets run. Depends on P07 repository release, accepted P04/P15 and P12 consumer integration. Own specification/player/toolchain; stdlib only if shared adapter changes required. Primary owns boards.

Primary syntax decision: additive <frame-effect id="component-id" effect-id="registered-id" effect-version="exact-version" props='{"parameters":{...}}' start="..." duration="..."/>. Preserve existing XML timing syntax and component IDs; renderer component type is FrameEffect. props.parameters is data only and validated against registered descriptor; reject unknown registry ID/version/parameters instead of silently rendering nothing. No executable expressions or dynamic imports from user data. JSON must be a plain object and dangerous prototype keys rejected. All existing standard scene/layer timing/frozen-ID handling applies. Context width/height/fps/seed/assets comes from composition; seek is composition-absolute integer frame, interval visibility [startFrame,endFrame), no implicit local clock restart. Resolve bundled assets before mounting; caller supplies approved registry and local asset mapping, default built-in registry explicit and deterministic.

Use one shared mount/seek/dispose implementation in both player and renderer, preserve cancellation and readiness. Wire the real XML DOM player and script-based renderer, not just new helper exports. Add spec draft section and working examples. Prove copied XML renders the actual particle/echo examples via clean packed consumer, no Babulus/TTS/network dependency. Repeated/reverse/random frames and frozen timing IDs must match direct TS preview. Include unknown ID/version, invalid params/JSON, cancellation/remount, visual-only provider-free and asset failure checks. Update P12 iframe/source generator only after package handoff. Primary and independent source review required; do not close P12 without executable XML evidence.

comments.text: D05b asset syntax and local/browser resolution decisions added to initiative. Scope extends CLI src/cli.ts assetBaseDir plumbing and shared timing metadata classification as needed.
